int audio_test_ogg_opus_dump(const int16_t *pcm, size_t nsamples,
                             unsigned int rate, unsigned int bitrate)
{
  const uint8_t *page_pkt[OGG_PACKETS_PER_PAGE];
  uint16_t page_len[OGG_PACKETS_PER_PAGE];
  uint8_t head[19];
  uint8_t tags[8 + 4 + sizeof(OGG_VENDOR) - 1 + 4];
  const uint8_t *pagep;
  uint16_t pagelen;
  unsigned int frame = rate / 1000 * OGG_FRAME_MS;
  unsigned int npage = 0;
  uint32_t serial = 0x4f505553;        /* "OPUS"; any constant will do */
  uint32_t seq = 0;
  uint64_t granule = 0;
  OpusEncoder *enc;
  uint8_t *packets;
  uint8_t *out;
  uint8_t *psram_enc = NULL;
  size_t outcap;
  size_t outlen = 0;
  size_t offset = 0;
  size_t pktoff = 0;
  int lookahead = 0;
  int encsize;
  int ret = OK;
  int n;

  if (pcm == NULL || nsamples == 0 || frame == 0)
    {
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  /* Room for the encoded file: the requested bitrate plus a wide margin for
   * VBR excursions and page headers.  This is PSRAM, where the cost of being
   * generous is nil, and running out halfway would waste a recording.
   */

  outcap = nsamples / rate * bitrate / 4 + 65536;
  out = bk7258_psram_malloc(outcap);
  packets = bk7258_psram_malloc((size_t)OGG_MAX_PACKET *
                                OGG_PACKETS_PER_PAGE);
  if (out == NULL || packets == NULL)
    {
      printf("audio_test: no PSRAM for the Ogg buffers\n");
      ret = -ENOMEM;
      goto free_buffers;
    }

  /* The encoder state goes in SRAM when it fits: it is touched constantly
   * during encoding and PSRAM is mapped non-cacheable.  PSRAM is the
   * fallback rather than the default for that reason alone.
   */

  encsize = opus_encoder_get_size(1);
  printf("audio_test: opus encoder state is %d bytes\n", encsize);

  enc = malloc((size_t)encsize);
  if (enc == NULL)
    {
      psram_enc = bk7258_psram_malloc((size_t)encsize);
      enc = (OpusEncoder *)psram_enc;
      printf("audio_test: encoder state in PSRAM (SRAM had no room)\n");
    }

  if (enc == NULL)
    {
      printf("audio_test: no memory for the opus encoder\n");
      ret = -ENOMEM;
      goto free_buffers;
    }

  n = opus_encoder_init(enc, (opus_int32)rate, 1, OPUS_APPLICATION_VOIP);
  if (n != OPUS_OK)
    {
      printf("audio_test: opus_encoder_init failed: %d\n", n);
      ret = -EIO;
      goto free_encoder;
    }

  opus_encoder_ctl(enc, OPUS_SET_BITRATE((opus_int32)bitrate));
  opus_encoder_ctl(enc, OPUS_SET_VBR(1));
  opus_encoder_ctl(enc, OPUS_SET_SIGNAL(OPUS_SIGNAL_VOICE));
  opus_encoder_ctl(enc, OPUS_GET_LOOKAHEAD(&lookahead));

  /* Identification header.  Pre-skip is in 48 kHz units like every other
   * granule figure in the stream.
   */

  memcpy(head, "OpusHead", 8);
  head[8] = 1;
  head[9] = 1;
  ogg_put16(head + 10, (uint16_t)(lookahead * 48000 / (int)rate));
  ogg_put32(head + 12, rate);
  ogg_put16(head + 16, 0);
  head[18] = 0;

  pagep = head;
  pagelen = sizeof(head);
  n = ogg_write_page(out + outlen, outcap - outlen, serial, seq++, 0,
                     true, false, &pagep, &pagelen, 1);
  if (n < 0)
    {
      ret = n;
      goto free_encoder;
    }

  outlen += n;

  /* Comment header.  It carries no comments, but the format requires it. */

  memcpy(tags, "OpusTags", 8);
  ogg_put32(tags + 8, sizeof(OGG_VENDOR) - 1);
  memcpy(tags + 12, OGG_VENDOR, sizeof(OGG_VENDOR) - 1);
  ogg_put32(tags + 12 + sizeof(OGG_VENDOR) - 1, 0);

  pagep = tags;
  pagelen = sizeof(tags);
  n = ogg_write_page(out + outlen, outcap - outlen, serial, seq++, 0,
                     false, false, &pagep, &pagelen, 1);
  if (n < 0)
    {
      ret = n;
      goto free_encoder;
    }

  outlen += n;

  /* Encode whole frames only.  A trailing partial frame is padded with
   * silence rather than dropped, so the file length matches what was asked
   * for instead of being short by up to one frame.
   */

  while (offset < nsamples)
    {
      int16_t tail[960];
      const int16_t *src = pcm + offset;
      size_t have = nsamples - offset;
      bool lastframe;

      if (have < frame)
        {
          memset(tail, 0, sizeof(tail));
          memcpy(tail, src, have * sizeof(int16_t));
          src = tail;
        }

      n = opus_encode(enc, src, (int)frame, packets + pktoff,
                      OGG_MAX_PACKET);
      if (n < 0)
        {
          printf("audio_test: opus_encode failed: %d\n", n);
          ret = -EIO;
          goto free_encoder;
        }

      page_pkt[npage] = packets + pktoff;
      page_len[npage] = (uint16_t)n;
      pktoff += (size_t)n;
      npage++;

      offset += frame;
      granule += (uint64_t)frame * 48000 / rate;
      lastframe = offset >= nsamples;

      if (offset / frame % OGG_YIELD_FRAMES == 0)
        {
          usleep(OGG_YIELD_US);
        }

      if (npage == OGG_PACKETS_PER_PAGE || lastframe)
        {
          n = ogg_write_page(out + outlen, outcap - outlen, serial, seq++,
                             granule, false, lastframe, page_pkt, page_len,
                             npage);
          if (n < 0)
            {
              printf("audio_test: Ogg page would not fit: %d\n", n);
              ret = n;
              goto free_encoder;
            }

          outlen += n;
          npage = 0;
          pktoff = 0;
        }
    }

  /* Hand the file to the retry path before printing it, so a dump the
   * console mangles can be repeated without recording again.
   */

  if (g_ogg_file != NULL)
    {
      bk7258_psram_free(g_ogg_file);
    }

  g_ogg_file = out;
  g_ogg_len = outlen;
  g_ogg_rate = rate;
  g_ogg_bitrate = bitrate;
  out = NULL;

  audio_test_ogg_redump();

free_encoder:
  if (psram_enc != NULL)
    {
      bk7258_psram_free(psram_enc);
    }
  else
    {
      free(enc);
    }

free_buffers:
  if (packets != NULL)
    {
      bk7258_psram_free(packets);
    }

  if (out != NULL)
    {
      bk7258_psram_free(out);
    }

  return ret;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * app/audio_test/audio_test_stream.h
 *
 * Continuous capture split into fixed-length chunks and uploaded while the
 * next chunk is still being recorded.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifndef __APP_AUDIO_TEST_AUDIO_TEST_STREAM_H
#define __APP_AUDIO_TEST_AUDIO_TEST_STREAM_H

/****************************************************************************
 * Included Files
 ****************************************************************************/

#include <nuttx/config.h>

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Types
 ****************************************************************************/

/* Opaque: everything in here is shared between the capture thread and the
 * uploader, and the locking that makes that safe is this module's business
 * alone.
 */

struct audio_test_stream_ctx_s;

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Function Prototypes
 ****************************************************************************/

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: audio_test_stream_open
 *
 * Description:
 *   Allocate the chunk ring and start the uploader thread.
 *
 *   The ring is what decouples the two halves.  Capture runs on a deadline
 *   it does not control -- the ADC delivers a buffer every few milliseconds
 *   whether or not anyone is ready for it -- while an upload takes as long
 *   as the network feels like taking.  Handing a chunk straight to a socket
 *   from the capture path would make every network stall a capture stall,
 *   and the plan is explicit that congestion must not block audio, the
 *   mailbox heartbeat or the keys.  So capture only ever copies into a free
 *   slot and signals; if the uploader has fallen behind, capture discards
 *   the oldest queued chunk and keeps recording rather than waiting for it.
 *
 *   Dropping a chunk is a deliberate choice and not a silent one: the
 *   upload protocol tolerates a gap in the sequence numbers, and a counted
 *   drop reported at the end is far better than audio that stutters
 *   whenever Wi-Fi does.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   host     - IPv4 address of the receiver, in dotted-quad form
 *   port     - TCP port it is listening on
 *   rate     - sample rate of the audio that will be fed in
 *   chunk_ms - chunk length in milliseconds
 *   bitrate  - Opus target bits per second
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   A context, or NULL on failure (a message has been printed).
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

struct audio_test_stream_ctx_s *
audio_test_stream_open(const char *host, int port, unsigned int rate,
                       unsigned int chunk_ms, unsigned int bitrate);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: audio_test_stream_feed
 *
 * Description:
 *   Hand captured samples to the chunker.  Called from the capture thread
 *   once per buffer the driver returns.
 *
 *   Never blocks and never fails: if there is nowhere to put the samples it
 *   frees a slot by dropping the oldest chunk that has not started
 *   uploading yet.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   ctx      - from audio_test_stream_open()
 *   samples  - interleaved 16-bit samples as they came from the driver
 *   nsamples - number of samples available at samples, all channels
 *   stride   - 1 for mono, 2 to take the left channel of an interleaved
 *              pair.  With the AEC echo reference compiled in the capture
 *              stream is L/R interleaved and only the left channel is the
 *              microphone, so the de-interleave happens here rather than
 *              forcing the caller to stage a copy of every buffer.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void audio_test_stream_feed(struct audio_test_stream_ctx_s *ctx,
                            const int16_t *samples, size_t nsamples,
                            unsigned int stride);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: audio_test_stream_close
 *
 * Description:
 *   Flush whatever is queued, stop the uploader and release everything.
 *
 *   A partially filled chunk is sent too: the last couple of seconds of a
 *   session are usually the reason it was started.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void audio_test_stream_close(struct audio_test_stream_ctx_s *ctx);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: audio_test_stream_report
 *
 * Description:
 *   Print the running counters.  Safe to call while capture is running.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void audio_test_stream_report(struct audio_test_stream_ctx_s *ctx);

#endif /* __APP_AUDIO_TEST_AUDIO_TEST_STREAM_H */

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Stand-in for the cloud upload endpoint.

Accepts the chunked uploads `audio_test stream` produces, stores each chunk as
its own file and answers 200 so the board can tell a delivered chunk from a
lost one.

The board sends one HTTP POST per chunk with the metadata in headers, so this
only has to be enough of an HTTP server to read a request and answer it.  It
is deliberately not http.server: that logs to stderr in a shape nobody wants
and makes reading an exact Content-Length awkward.

On exit it reports what arrived, checks each chunk actually decodes, and can
merge the session into one file to listen to -- which is the point of the
exercise, because a chunk that decodes on its own still proves nothing about
whether the chunk boundaries land where they should.

SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""

import argparse
import os
import re
import shutil
import socket
import socketserver
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time

# Chunks are a few kilobytes; anything far past that is a bug or a stray
# connection, and reading it into memory unbounded would be the wrong answer
# either way.

MAX_BODY = 4 << 20

# Guard against a client that connects and says nothing.

SOCKET_TIMEOUT = 30.0

state_lock = threading.Lock()
sessions = {}


class Session:
    def __init__(self, sid, outdir):
        self.sid = sid
        self.dir = outdir
        self.chunks = {}          # sequence -> (path, bytes, duration_ms)
        self.first_seen = time.time()
        self.last_seen = self.first_seen
        os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)


def read_headers(f):
    """Read request line and headers, returning (path, dict) or None."""
    line = f.readline(8192)
    if not line:
        return None

    request = line.decode("latin-1").strip()
    headers = {}

    while True:
        line = f.readline(8192)
        if not line or line in (b"\r\n", b"\n"):
            break

        text = line.decode("latin-1").strip()
        if ":" not in text:
            continue

        key, _, value = text.partition(":")
        headers[key.strip().lower()] = value.strip()

    return request, headers


class Handler(socketserver.StreamRequestHandler):
    timeout = SOCKET_TIMEOUT

    def handle(self):
        parsed = read_headers(self.rfile)
        if parsed is None:
            return

        request, headers = parsed

        try:
            length = int(headers.get("content-length", "0"))
        except ValueError:
            self.respond(400, "bad Content-Length")
            return

        if length < 0 or length > MAX_BODY:
            self.respond(413, "body too large")
            return

        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
        if len(body) != length:
            print(f"  ! short body: {len(body)} of {length} bytes")
            self.respond(400, "short body")
            return

        sid = headers.get("x-session-id", "nosession")
        seq = headers.get("x-sequence", "?")
        start_ms = headers.get("x-start-ms", "?")
        duration_ms = headers.get("x-duration-ms", "?")

        # Answer before doing anything on disk.  The board times its send out
        # after a few seconds, and making it wait for a filesystem it cannot
        # see would turn a slow disk into a dropped chunk.

        self.respond(200, "ok")

        try:
            seq_n = int(seq)
        except ValueError:
            seq_n = -1

        with state_lock:
            session = sessions.get(sid)
            if session is None:
                session = Session(sid, os.path.join(self.server.outdir,
                                                    f"session_{sid}"))
                sessions[sid] = session
                print(f"[{sid}] new session -> {session.dir}")

            name = os.path.join(session.dir, f"chunk_{seq_n:04d}.opus")
            session.chunks[seq_n] = (name, len(body), duration_ms)
            session.last_seen = time.time()
            count = len(session.chunks)

        with open(name, "wb") as out:
            out.write(body)

        print(f"[{sid}] seq={seq} start={start_ms}ms dur={duration_ms}ms "
              f"{len(body)} bytes -> {os.path.basename(name)} "
              f"({count} so far)")

    def respond(self, code, text):
        reason = {200: "OK", 400: "Bad Request", 413: "Payload Too Large"}
        body = text.encode()
        head = (f"HTTP/1.1 {code} {reason.get(code, 'Error')}\r\n"
                f"Content-Type: text/plain\r\n"
                f"Content-Length: {len(body)}\r\n"
                f"Connection: close\r\n\r\n").encode()
        try:
            self.wfile.write(head + body)
            self.wfile.flush()
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, socket.timeout):
            pass

    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass


class Server(socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer):
    allow_reuse_address = True
    daemon_threads = True

    def __init__(self, addr, handler, outdir):
        self.outdir = outdir
        super().__init__(addr, handler)


def probe_duration_ms(path):
    """Decoded length of one chunk in ms, or None if it will not decode."""
    if shutil.which("ffprobe") is None:
        return None

    try:
        out = subprocess.run(
            ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries",
             "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", path],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
        if out.returncode != 0 or not out.stdout.strip():
            return -1
        return int(float(out.stdout.strip()) * 1000)
    except (subprocess.SubprocessError, ValueError):
        return -1


def summarise(session, merge):
    order = sorted(session.chunks)
    if not order:
        return

    print(f"\n=== session {session.sid} ===")
    print(f"  {len(order)} chunk(s), {order[0]}..{order[-1]}")

    missing = [n for n in range(order[0], order[-1] + 1)
               if n not in session.chunks]
    if missing:
        # Not necessarily a fault: the board drops a queued chunk rather than
        # let a slow upload stall capture, and the protocol allows the gap.
        print(f"  gaps at {missing} (dropped on the board, or lost)")
    else:
        print("  no gaps")

    total = sum(v[1] for v in session.chunks.values())
    print(f"  {total} byte(s) received")

    bad = []
    drift = []
    for n in order:
        path, nbytes, claimed = session.chunks[n]
        got = probe_duration_ms(path)
        if got is None:
            break
        if got < 0:
            bad.append(n)
            continue
        try:
            want = int(claimed)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        # The encoder pads the last frame with silence, so up to one 20 ms
        # frame of overshoot is expected rather than wrong.
        if abs(got - want) > 25:
            drift.append((n, want, got))

    if bad:
        print(f"  DOES NOT DECODE: {bad}")
    if drift:
        print("  duration disagrees with the header (ms, claimed vs "
              f"decoded): {drift}")
    if not bad and not drift:
        print("  every chunk decodes and matches its declared duration")

    if merge:
        merge_session(session, order)


def merge_session(session, order):
    if shutil.which("ffmpeg") is None:
        print("  ffmpeg not found, skipping the merge")
        return

    listing = os.path.join(session.dir, "concat.txt")
    with open(listing, "w") as f:
        for n in order:
            path = os.path.abspath(session.chunks[n][0])
            f.write(f"file '{path}'\n")

    merged = os.path.join(session.dir, "session.wav")
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
         "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", listing, merged],
        capture_output=True, text=True)

    if result.returncode == 0:
        print(f"  merged -> {merged}")
        print(f"  listen: ffplay -nodisp -autoexit {merged}")
    else:
        print(f"  merge failed: {result.stderr.strip()[:200]}")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=9001)
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0")
    parser.add_argument("--out",
                        default="/home/mi/vela_competition_continue/data",
                        help="where sessions are written")
    parser.add_argument("--no-merge", action="store_true",
                        help="skip building session.wav on exit")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    os.makedirs(args.out, exist_ok=True)

    server = Server((args.host, args.port), Handler, args.out)
    print(f"listening on {args.host}:{args.port}, writing to {args.out}")
    print("board: audio_test stream <this host> "
          f"{args.port} -t 30 -c 2000")
    print("Ctrl-C to stop and summarise\n")

    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nstopping")
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        with state_lock:
            found = list(sessions.values())
        for session in found:
            summarise(session, not args.no_merge)
        if not found:
            print("no chunks arrived")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/bin/bash
# autoflash.sh -- flash the BK7258 board without pressing RST by hand.
#
# How it works
# ------------
# bk_loader resets the board by pulsing DTR/RTS (CCommPort::do_reset_signal),
# but this board has no auto-reset circuit on those lines -- measured: pulsing
# either one produces zero bytes.  That is why a human has to press RST while
# bk_loader is looping on "Getting Bus...".
#
# The bootrom only answers the LinkCheck handshake for a short window after a
# reset.  Measured on this board: issuing "reboot" over the CP shell gives
# about 473 ms of silence (0.005 s -> 0.478 s) before firmware output starts,
# and the shell prompt is back at 1.04 s.  So the window is wide enough.
#
# bk_loader does not take TIOCEXCL on the tty, so a second process can write
# into the same port while bk_loader is looping.  Writing "reboot" there makes
# the running firmware reset itself -- exactly what pressing RST does, only
# scripted.  Verified: "Gotten Bus..." arrives ~0.5 s after the write.
#
# IMPORTANT: once the bus is taken, anything else written to the port would
# corrupt the protocol, so the reboot loop stops the moment "Gotten Bus"
# appears in the log.

set -u

ROOT=/home/mi/vela_competition
LOADER="$ROOT/bk_loader"
DEFAULT_IMAGE="$ROOT/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
RUNTIME_DIR="$ROOT/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/logs/runtime"
EXPECTED_SIZE=2646016

PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
PORTNUM=0

# Two independent baud rates, do not conflate them.
#
# BAUD is only how fast bk_loader talks to the bootrom.  CONSOLE_BAUD is what
# the firmware's console runs at, which is fixed by the build (defconfig), so
# raising the flash speed must not change it.  Using one variable for both
# meant that after "-b 1500000" the post-flash screen opened at 1500000 and
# nothing typed into it worked.
BAUD=115200
CONSOLE_BAUD=115200
IMAGE="$DEFAULT_IMAGE"
LOG="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash.log"
REBOOT_TRIES=8
REBOOT_INTERVAL=1.5

# Overall timeout is derived from the image size, never hard-coded.
#
# A fixed 180 s was wrong and actively harmful: 2,646,016 bytes at 115200 baud
# is 10 bits per byte on the wire, i.e. ~230 s of writing alone, plus ~10 s of
# 64K erase.  timeout(1) killed a real flash at "Writing Flash ... 69%",
# leaving the board with an erased-but-incomplete image.  Computed below as
# transfer time x 2 plus 60 s of headroom.
OVERALL_TIMEOUT=0
ATTACH_SERIAL=0
SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=0
TEST_ONLY=0

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
用法: autoflash.sh [选项]

  -i <file>    要烧录的镜像，默认 all-app.bin
  -p <port>    串口设备，默认 /dev/ttyUSB0
  -n <num>     bk_loader 的端口号，默认 0
  -b <baud>    烧录波特率，默认 115200（只影响下载速度）
  -B <baud>    控制台波特率，默认 115200（固件编译时定死的，一般别改）
  -s           跳过 all-app.bin 字节数校验
  -a           烧完自动挂上串口看日志
  -t           只测握手，不写 flash（用 read 代替 download）
  -h           显示本帮助

说明: 不需要手按 RST。脚本会在 bk_loader 握手循环期间，从另一个进程往
      同一个串口写 reboot 来触发软复位。
EOF
}

while getopts "i:p:n:b:B:sath" opt; do
  case "$opt" in
    i) IMAGE="$OPTARG" ;;
    p) PORT="$OPTARG" ;;
    n) PORTNUM="$OPTARG" ;;
    b) BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
    B) CONSOLE_BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
    s) SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=1 ;;
    a) ATTACH_SERIAL=1 ;;
    t) TEST_ONLY=1 ;;
    h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) usage; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

die() { echo "错误: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. 前置检查

[ -x "$LOADER" ] || die "找不到 bk_loader: $LOADER"
[ -f "$IMAGE" ]  || die "找不到镜像: $IMAGE"
[ -c "$PORT" ]   || die "串口不存在: $PORT（板子插了吗？）"
mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_DIR" || die "无法创建运行记录目录: $RUNTIME_DIR"

SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$IMAGE")
SHA=$(sha256sum "$IMAGE" | cut -d' ' -f1)

# 10 bits on the wire per byte (8N1 plus start and stop).
XFER_SECS=$(( SIZE * 10 / BAUD ))
OVERALL_TIMEOUT=$(( XFER_SECS * 2 + 60 ))

echo "=== 待烧录镜像 ==="
echo "  路径   : $IMAGE"
echo "  字节数 : $SIZE"
echo "  SHA256 : $SHA"
echo "  串口   : $PORT"
echo "  烧录   : ${BAUD} baud，传输约 ${XFER_SECS}s，超时上限 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s"
echo "  控制台 : ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud（烧完会恢复成这个）"

if [ "$SKIP_SIZE_CHECK" -eq 0 ] && [ "$(basename "$IMAGE")" = "all-app.bin" ]; then
  if [ "$SIZE" -ne "$EXPECTED_SIZE" ]; then
    die "all-app.bin 应为 $EXPECTED_SIZE 字节，实际 $SIZE。打包可能不完整，用 -s 可跳过此检查"
  fi
  echo "  字节数校验通过"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------- 2. 释放串口占用

echo
echo "=== 释放串口 ==="
HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
  echo "  当前占用: $HOLDERS"

  pkill -f "picocom.*$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1
  pkill -f "minicom.*$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1

  sleep 0.5
  HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
  if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
    die "串口仍被占用: $HOLDERS。手动处理后重试（参考 docs/端口冲突解决办法.md）"
  fi
fi
echo "  串口空闲"

# Console baud, not flash baud: the only thing written through this port
# before bk_loader takes over is the "reboot" command, and the firmware's
# console is listening at CONSOLE_BAUD.
stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts \
  || die "stty 配置失败"

# --------------------------------------------------- 3. 启动 bk_loader 并软复位

echo
: > "$LOG"
PIDFILE="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash.$$.pid"
: > "$PIDFILE"

# The in-loop reset works at any -b, and here is why it is safe to rely on:
# bk_loader opens the tty at 115200 no matter what -b says, handshakes there,
# and only switches to the requested rate once it owns the bus.  Measured from
# a real 1500000 run:
#
#   cmdline: ... bk_loader download -p 0 -b 1500000 ...
#   Current port : /dev/ttyUSB0 + BaudRate : 115200 connect success
#   Getting Bus... / Gotten Bus... / All Finished Successfully
#
# So while we are writing "reboot" the line is still at 115200 and the
# firmware console decodes it fine.  An earlier version of this script
# disabled the retry loop for BAUD != CONSOLE_BAUD on the theory that the port
# had already been switched up -- that was reasoning without measurement, and
# it broke a mechanism that worked.

if [ "$TEST_ONLY" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "=== 只测握手，不写 flash ==="
  set -- read -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" -f "$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash_probe.bin@0-1000"
else
  echo "=== 开始烧录（无需按 RST）==="
  set -- download -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" -s 0 -i "$IMAGE"
fi

# Output goes to the terminal *and* the log.
#
# bk_loader draws its erase/write progress with cli_printf_progress_bar,
# which emits "Erasing Flash ... 42%\r" -- carriage return, no newline.  Two
# things are needed to see that live: tee, so the bytes reach the terminal at
# all, and stdbuf -o0, because with a pipe on stdout glibc would otherwise
# block-buffer 4 KB at a time and the bar would arrive in lurches.
#
# The PID is stashed in a file because with a pipeline $! would be tee's.
(
  stdbuf -o0 -e0 timeout "$OVERALL_TIMEOUT" "$LOADER" "$@" &
  echo $! > "$PIDFILE"
  wait $!
) 2>&1 | tee "$LOG" &
PIPELINE_PID=$!

LOADER_PID=""
for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
  if [ -s "$PIDFILE" ]; then LOADER_PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE"); break; fi
  sleep 0.1
done
[ -n "$LOADER_PID" ] || die "无法获取 bk_loader 进程号"

# Wait for it to actually enter the retry loop before poking the board.
for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
  grep -q "Getting Bus" "$LOG" && break
  kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
  sleep 0.1
done

if ! kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "  bk_loader 提前退出:"
  tail -5 "$LOG" | sed 's/^/    | /'
  wait "$LOADER_PID"; exit 1
fi

GOT_BUS=0

echo "  bk_loader 已进入握手循环，开始发送软复位"

for i in $(seq 1 "$REBOOT_TRIES"); do
  if grep -aq "Gotten Bus" "$LOG"; then GOT_BUS=1; break; fi
  kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break

  # If the console happens to be bridged to the AP shell, escape back to the
  # CP shell first: Ctrl-] then '.'.
  #
  # The trailing newline after the escape is essential.  Without it the CP
  # shell buffers all of it as a single line and sees "\x1d.reboot", answers
  # "cmd NOT found: .reboot" and never resets -- which made every attempt here
  # fall through to the manual RST prompt.  Measured: with the flush the board
  # reboots, without it it never does.
  printf '\035' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
  printf '.'    > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
  printf '\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
  printf 'reboot\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
  echo "  第 $i 次软复位已发出"

  # Poll frequently so we stop writing the instant the bus is taken --
  # further bytes would corrupt the download protocol.
  for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
    if grep -q "Gotten Bus" "$LOG"; then GOT_BUS=1; break; fi
    sleep 0.1
  done
  [ "$GOT_BUS" -eq 1 ] && break
done

if [ "$GOT_BUS" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "  握手成功，下面是 bk_loader 的实时输出："
else
  echo "  软复位没能拿到总线 —— 现在请手动按一次 RST（按一下就彻底松手）"
  echo "  bk_loader 仍在循环握手，按下去就会接上"
fi

# Waiting on the pipeline, not the loader: tee has to finish draining before
# the log is complete enough to judge the outcome.
wait "$PIPELINE_PID"
RC=$?
rm -f "$PIDFILE"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ 4. 判定

echo
echo "=== 结果 ==="
if grep -aq "All Finished Successfully" "$LOG"; then
  echo "  烧录成功"
  grep -aE "Total Test Time|EraseFlash ->pass" "$LOG" \
    | tail -3 | sed 's/^/    | /'
else
  echo "  烧录失败（退出码 $RC）"

  # Distinguish "never got started" from "killed halfway through the write",
  # because the second case leaves the board unbootable and must be re-flashed
  # before anything else is attempted.
  LAST_PCT=$(tr '\r' '\n' < "$LOG" | grep -aoE "Writing Flash \.\.\. [0-9]+%" \
             | tail -1)
  if [ -n "$LAST_PCT" ]; then
    echo
    echo "  !! flash 已被擦除但只写到 $LAST_PCT —— 固件不完整，板子起不来。"
    echo "     必须重新完整烧录一次才能恢复。"
    echo "     此时固件不响应 reboot，软复位无效，需要手动按一次 RST。"
  elif [ "$RC" -eq 124 ]; then
    echo "  !! 被超时中止（上限 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s）"
  fi

  echo
  echo "  完整日志: $LOG"
  exit 1
fi

# --------------------------------------------------------- 5. 可选挂回串口

# Put the line back to the console rate.  bk_loader left it at BAUD, and if
# that is not CONSOLE_BAUD then anything attaching afterwards -- screen, cat,
# minicom -- would see garbage and typing would do nothing.
if [ "$BAUD" != "$CONSOLE_BAUD" ]; then
  stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts \
    2>/dev/null
  echo "  串口已从 ${BAUD} 恢复为控制台的 ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud"
fi

if [ "$ATTACH_SERIAL" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo
  command -v picocom >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "找不到 picocom"
  echo "=== 挂上串口（Ctrl-A Ctrl-X 退出）==="
  sleep 1
  exec picocom -b "$CONSOLE_BAUD" --flow n --parity n --databits 8 "$PORT"
fi

echo
echo "  接串口看日志: picocom -b $CONSOLE_BAUD --flow n --parity n --databits 8 $PORT"

</content>
</file>

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Send synthetic chunks the way the board does, to test the receiver.

Uses ffmpeg to produce real 2 s Ogg Opus files so the receiver's decode check
is exercised against something that actually decodes, and deliberately skips
one sequence number to confirm the gap report works.
"""

import socket
import subprocess
import sys

HOST = "127.0.0.1"
PORT = 9001
SESSION = "deadbeef"
CHUNK_MS = 2000


def make_chunk(index, path):
    freq = 300 + 100 * index
    subprocess.run(
        ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
         "-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"sine=frequency={freq}:duration=2:r=16000",
         "-c:a", "libopus", "-b:a", "24000", "-ac", "1", path],
        check=True)
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        return f.read()


def post(seq, body):
    header = (
        f"POST /v1/audio/chunk HTTP/1.1\r\n"
        f"Host: {HOST}:{PORT}\r\n"
        f"User-Agent: bk7258-audio_test\r\n"
        f"Content-Type: audio/ogg\r\n"
        f"Content-Length: {len(body)}\r\n"
        f"X-Session-Id: {SESSION}\r\n"
        f"X-Sequence: {seq}\r\n"
        f"X-Start-Ms: {seq * CHUNK_MS}\r\n"
        f"X-Duration-Ms: {CHUNK_MS}\r\n"
        f"X-Sample-Rate: 16000\r\n"
        f"Connection: close\r\n"
        f"\r\n").encode()

    s = socket.create_connection((HOST, PORT), timeout=5)
    s.sendall(header + body)
    reply = s.recv(256)
    s.close()
    return reply.split(b"\r\n")[0].decode()


def main():
    # Sequence 2 is missing on purpose: the board drops a queued chunk rather
    # than stall capture, so the receiver has to report the gap and not treat
    # it as corruption.
    for seq in (0, 1, 3, 4):
        body = make_chunk(seq, f"/tmp/chunk_{seq}.opus")
        status = post(seq, body)
        print(f"seq={seq} {len(body)} bytes -> {status}")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# 做了什么

**板子侧**，新增 `audio_test stream <ip> <port>`：

```
采集线程（主线程，拥有 audio 设备）
  ├─ 每个 buffer：去交织取 MIC1 → 一次 strided copy 进 PSRAM 槽位
  └─ 槽位满 2 s → 标记 READY + signal → 立刻换下一个槽位
                                          ↓
上传线程（优先级低 10 档）
  └─ 取最小序号的 READY → 独立 Ogg Opus 流 → HTTP POST → 槽位归还
```

采集路径上**只有一次内存拷贝**，编码和 socket 全在另一侧。上传跟不上时丢掉最老的排队块并计数，绝不等网络 —— 这是文档「拥塞不能阻塞音频/heartbeat/按键」的直接落地。4 个槽位（16 kHz / 2 s 下每个 64 KiB PSRAM），允许上传落后整整一块还能追上。

每块是**自包含的 Ogg 流**（各自的 OpusHead/OpusTags、独立 serial、granule 从 0 起），代价是每块约 110 字节头部开销，换来的是缺号和单块重试都成立 —— 切片式的连续流做不到这两点。编码器创建一次、每块 `OPUS_RESET_STATE`，否则块首帧会引用解码端没见过的样本，听起来是「咔」一声。

报文按 HTTP POST 发，元数据在头里：`X-Sequence` / `X-Start-Ms` / `X-Duration-Ms` / `X-Session-Id` / `X-Sample-Rate`。

**电脑侧** `tools/chunk_server.py`：每块单独存盘，退出时报告缺号、逐块 ffprobe 验证能解码且时长与声明一致、ffmpeg 合并成 `session.wav`。

#!/bin/bash
# Send a command to the board's AP console and show the clean reply.
#
# The NSH line editor echoes every keystroke wrapped in cursor-control escapes,
# so the raw log is unreadable; strip the escapes and the per-character echo
# noise before showing anything.
#
# usage: ser.sh "<command>" [wait_seconds] [tail_lines]

PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
LOG=/tmp/serial.log
CMD="$1"
WAIT="${2:-3}"
LINES="${3:-15}"

MARK=$(wc -c < "$LOG")

if [ -n "$CMD" ]; then
  sg dialout -c "printf '%s\r\n' \"$CMD\" > $PORT"
fi

sleep "$WAIT"

# Only the bytes that arrived after the command was written, so a long log
# does not bury the answer.
tail -c +$((MARK + 1)) "$LOG" \
  | sed -e 's/\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[a-zA-Z]//g' \
        -e 's/\x1b\[K//g' \
        -e 's/\r/\n/g' \
  | grep -v '^$' \
  | tail -n "$LINES"

# PSRAM（`bk7258_psram_malloc`，独立 `mm_initialize()` 堆，普通 `malloc()` 到不了）

| 用途 | 大小 | 代码位置 |
|---|---|---|
| **4 个分块槽位（录音暂存）** | 4 × 64,000 = **256,000 B** | `audio_test_stream.c:665` |
| 编码输出缓冲 | 65,536 B | `audio_test_stream.c:674` |
| opus 编码器状态 | ~38,560 B | `audio_test_ogg.c:618` |
| Ogg 单页 packet 暂存 | 1275 × 50 = 63,750 B | `audio_test_ogg.c:594` |
| | **合计 ≈ 414 KiB** | |

槽位大小 = `rate × chunk_ms / 1000 × 2`，16 kHz / 2 s 就是 64,000 B（板子日志里报的 "62 KiB" 是 /1024 取整）。

# SRAM 主堆

| 用途 | 大小 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| **`audio_test` 任务栈** | 32,768 B | **采集循环跑在这里**（`CMakeLists.txt` / `Makefile` 的 `STACKSIZE`） |
| **上传 pthread 栈** | 32,768 B | `STREAM_STACKSIZE`，`pthread_attr_setstacksize` |
| ctx 结构体 | ~200 B | `calloc`，槽位描述符 + 锁 + 计数器 |
| 编码器句柄结构体 | ~32 B | `calloc`，只存几个指针 |
| 音频驱动流水线缓冲 | 4 × 2 KiB = 8,192 B | 由 audio upper half 通过 `AUDIOIOC_ALLOCBUFFER` 分配 |

# 为什么栈只能在 SRAM

NuttX 的 pthread 栈从任务组的堆里取，这个 flat build 里就是那个唯一的 SRAM 主堆 —— **没有办法把线程栈放到 PSRAM**。

这正是刚才 `pthread_create failed: 12` 的根因：`opus_encoder_get_size(1)` 那 38.5 KiB 原来是 SRAM 优先分配的，它先把主堆吃掉，32 KiB 的线程栈就申请不到了。所以我把编码器状态改成对这条路径**强制走 PSRAM**（`prefer_psram=true`），把 SRAM 让给唯一非它不可的东西。

代价是编码器状态落在非 cacheable 的 PSRAM 上，访问变慢 —— 但这条路径每 2 s 音频才编一次、耗时几十毫秒，时间预算宽得离谱，所以不心疼。一次性的 `audio_test opus` 路径独占整个 SRAM 堆，仍然走快的那条（`prefer_psram=false`）。

# 两者的关系

```
audio_test 任务（优先级 100，栈 32 KiB @ SRAM）
  └─ mq_timedreceive 收驱动的 buffer
       └─ 去交织，一次 strided copy ──写入──> 槽位 [PSRAM]
                                              │ 满 2 s → READY + signal
上传 pthread（优先级 90，栈 32 KiB @ SRAM）    ↓
  └─ 取 READY 槽位 [PSRAM] → 编码 [PSRAM] → TCP → 槽位归还
```

优先级差 10 档是故意的：NuttX 同优先级内是 FIFO 调度，如果上传线程和采集同级，它能在一整个 encode 期间霸着 CPU，让采集赶不上 ADC 的节奏。压低它使这个顺序变成显式约束，而不是赌 `usleep` 恰好插在合适的位置。

class Session:
    """One recording session, named by when it arrived here.

    The name deliberately comes from this machine's clock and not from the
    board's.  The board has no RTC and nothing sets its time, so the session
    id it sends is seconds since boot -- the first real session came through
    as 000000f9, which is 249.  That is unique enough to separate two
    sessions but says nothing about when either happened, which is the one
    thing a directory name is good for.
    """

    def __init__(self, sid, root):
        self.sid = sid
        self.stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

        name = f"rec_{self.stamp}"
        outdir = os.path.join(root, name)

        # Two sessions inside the same second would otherwise land in one
        # directory and interleave their chunks.  It takes a board reboot
        # mid-second to do it, but the failure would look like corrupted
        # audio rather than a naming problem, so it is cheap to rule out.
        if os.path.exists(outdir):
            name = f"{name}_{sid}"
            outdir = os.path.join(root, name)

        self.name = name
        self.dir = outdir
        self.chunks = {}          # sequence -> (path, bytes, duration_ms)
        self.first_seen = time.time()
        self.last_seen = self.first_seen
        os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)

def merge_session(session, order, also_wav):
    """Join the chunks into one file.

    Done with `-c:a copy`, so the Opus packets are moved into a single Ogg
    stream untouched.  Re-encoding would be the obvious way to produce one
    file and the wrong one: the chunks are already lossy, and decoding and
    re-encoding them would stack a second generation of loss on top for no
    gain.  Copying is also 40-odd times smaller than the decoded WAV this
    used to write -- 32 KiB against 1.3 MiB for fifteen seconds.
    """
    if shutil.which("ffmpeg") is None:
        print("  ffmpeg not found, skipping the merge")
        return

    listing = os.path.join(session.dir, "concat.txt")
    with open(listing, "w") as f:
        for n in order:
            path = os.path.abspath(session.chunks[n][0])
            f.write(f"file '{path}'\n")

    merged = os.path.join(session.dir, f"{session.name}.ogg")
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
         "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", listing,
         "-c:a", "copy", merged],
        capture_output=True, text=True)

    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f"  merge failed: {result.stderr.strip()[:200]}")
        return

    size = os.path.getsize(merged)
    print(f"  merged -> {merged} ({size} bytes, no re-encode)")
    print(f"  listen: ffplay -nodisp -autoexit {merged}")

    if not also_wav:
        return

    # Only on request: useful when the next step is a filter or a spectrum
    # rather than a listen, since those want PCM anyway.
    wav = os.path.join(session.dir, f"{session.name}.wav")
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
         "-i", merged, wav],
        capture_output=True, text=True)

    if result.returncode == 0:
        print(f"  also decoded -> {wav} ({os.path.getsize(wav)} bytes)")
    else:
        print(f"  wav decode failed: {result.stderr.strip()[:200]}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Count full-scale samples in raw s16le on stdin.

max_volume of 0.0 dB from volumedetect only says something touched full
scale, which a lossy decoder can do by overshoot alone.  What decides whether
the ADC was clipped is how many samples sit there and for how long, so count
them instead of reading one summary figure.
"""

import struct
import sys

data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
n = len(data) // 2
s = struct.unpack("<%dh" % n, data[:n * 2])

clip = sum(1 for x in s if x >= 32767 or x <= -32768)
near = sum(1 for x in s if abs(x) >= 32000)
peak = max(abs(x) for x in s)

# Longest unbroken run at full scale: a genuine clip flattens the top of a
# waveform for many samples in a row, while decoder overshoot is isolated.
run = best = 0
for x in s:
    if x >= 32767 or x <= -32768:
        run += 1
        best = max(best, run)
    else:
        run = 0

print("总样本 %d (%.2f s)" % (n, n / 16000.0))
print("峰值 %d / 32767" % peak)
print("满量程样本 %d  占比 %.4f%%" % (clip, 100.0 * clip / n))
print(">=32000 的样本 %d  占比 %.4f%%" % (near, 100.0 * near / n))
print("最长连续满量程 %d 个样本 (%.2f ms)" % (best, best * 1000.0 / 16000))

def merge_session(session, order, also_wav, keep_chunks):
    """Join the chunks into one file and drop the pieces.

    Done with `-c:a copy`, so the Opus packets are moved into a single Ogg
    stream untouched.  Re-encoding would be the obvious way to produce one
    file and the wrong one: the chunks are already lossy, and decoding and
    re-encoding them would stack a second generation of loss on top for no
    gain.  Copying is also 40-odd times smaller than the decoded WAV this
    used to write -- 32 KiB against 1.3 MiB for fifteen seconds.

    The chunks are only deleted after the merged file has been decoded back,
    because until that succeeds they are the only copy of the recording.  A
    merge that exits 0 is not sufficient evidence on its own: an unreadable
    concat list produces an empty output and a clean exit status.
    """
    if shutil.which("ffmpeg") is None:
        print("  ffmpeg not found, keeping the chunks")
        return

    # The concat list is scaffolding for ffmpeg, not a result, so it never
    # goes in the output directory.
    listing = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".txt", delete=False)
    try:
        for n in order:
            path = os.path.abspath(session.chunks[n][0])
            listing.write(f"file '{path}'\n")
        listing.close()

        result = subprocess.run(
            ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
             "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", listing.name,
             "-c:a", "copy", session.final],
            capture_output=True, text=True)
    finally:
        os.unlink(listing.name)

    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f"  merge failed, chunks kept in {session.dir}")
        print(f"    {result.stderr.strip()[:200]}")
        return

    merged_ms = probe_duration_ms(session.final)
    if merged_ms is not None and merged_ms <= 0:
        print(f"  merged file does not decode, chunks kept in {session.dir}")
        return

    size = os.path.getsize(session.final)
    print(f"  merged -> {session.final}")
    print(f"    {size} bytes, {merged_ms} ms, no re-encode")

    if also_wav:
        # Only on request: useful when the next step is a filter or a
        # spectrum rather than a listen, since those want PCM anyway.
        wav = f"{session.final[:-4]}.wav"
        decode = subprocess.run(
            ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
             "-i", session.final, wav],
            capture_output=True, text=True)

        if decode.returncode == 0:
            print(f"    also decoded -> {wav} "
                  f"({os.path.getsize(wav)} bytes)")
        else:
            print(f"    wav decode failed: {decode.stderr.strip()[:200]}")

    if keep_chunks:
        print(f"    chunks kept in {session.dir}")
    else:
        shutil.rmtree(session.dir, ignore_errors=True)

    print(f"  listen: ffplay -nodisp -autoexit {session.final}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Post one chunk that is not valid Ogg, to prove the delete is gated.

The point being checked is not that ffmpeg fails -- it is that when the merge
cannot be verified, the per-chunk files are still on disk afterwards.  They
are the only copy of a recording at that moment, so a delete that happens
anyway would be silent data loss.
"""

import socket
import sys

HOST = "127.0.0.1"
PORT = 9004
SESSION = "badf00d"


def post(seq, body):
    header = (
        f"POST /v1/audio/chunk HTTP/1.1\r\n"
        f"Host: {HOST}:{PORT}\r\n"
        f"Content-Type: audio/ogg\r\n"
        f"Content-Length: {len(body)}\r\n"
        f"X-Session-Id: {SESSION}\r\n"
        f"X-Sequence: {seq}\r\n"
        f"X-Start-Ms: {seq * 2000}\r\n"
        f"X-Duration-Ms: 2000\r\n"
        f"Connection: close\r\n"
        f"\r\n").encode()

    s = socket.create_connection((HOST, PORT), timeout=5)
    s.sendall(header + body)
    reply = s.recv(256)
    s.close()
    return reply.split(b"\r\n")[0].decode()


def main():
    for seq in (0, 1):
        body = b"this is not an ogg stream at all" * 40
        print(f"seq={seq} -> {post(seq, body)}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

流程基本对，但**「手动」只体现在一处**：合并本身是自动的，你手动的只是决定什么时候停服务器。

# 实际发生的事

```
板子每 2 s 一块
  └─ 一块 = 一个 HTTP POST = 一条独立 TCP 连接
       └─ 服务器收到立刻写盘  rec_20260817_173341.parts/chunk_0000.ogg
                                                      chunk_0001.ogg  ...
          （这一步全自动、实时，收一块写一块，不做任何合并）

你按 Ctrl-C
  └─ 检查序号有没有缺
  └─ 逐块 ffprobe：能不能解码、时长和声明的对不对
  └─ -c:a copy 拼成 rec_20260817_173341.ogg
  └─ 验证合并文件能解码
  └─ 删掉 .parts/ 目录
```

所以「合并 + 删小的留大的」这三件事是**你按 Ctrl-C 之后自动串起来跑完的**，不需要你手敲 ffmpeg。

# 但这里有个真的设计缺口

服务器**不知道一次录音什么时候结束**。每块都是独立连接，块与块之间没有任何「这是最后一块」的标记，所以它只能等你停进程才动手。

后果：

- 录 5 次再 Ctrl-C 一次，5 个会话会一起合并 —— 这个是对的，会话靠 `X-Session-Id` 区分，互不干扰
- 但**录完不会立刻拿到成品**，必须停服务器；想连续录就得反复起停
- 服务器要是崩了，什么都不会合并（分块都还在盘上，能手工救回来，但不优雅）

`Session` 里已经在记 `last_seen`（170 行每收一块更新一次），但目前**没人用它** —— 这就是缺的那块拼图。

# 两个补法

**A. 空闲超时自动收尾**（改接收端，不动固件）

板子每 2 s 必来一块，所以某个会话超过比如 8 s 没有新块，就可以判定它结束了，直接合并、删分块、打印结果。服务器一直挂着，录一次出一个成品，不用起停。

代价是超时值要拍：太短会把网络抖动误判成结束，太长则成品出得慢。8 s = 4 个块的间隔，我觉得够稳。

**B. 板子给最后一块打标记**（改固件）

`audio_test_stream_close()` 里给收尾那块加个 `X-Final: 1`，服务器见到就立刻收尾。判定是确定的，不用猜超时。

代价是最后一块要是丢了，服务器就永远等不到标记 —— 所以 B 实际上还是得配一个兜底超时，也就是说 A 是必须做的，B 是在 A 之上让常见情况变快。

是 TCP。两端都是：

| | 代码 | 位置 |
|---|---|---|
| 板子 | `socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0)` | `audio_test_stream.c:309` |
| 电脑 | `socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer` | `chunk_server.py:197` |

`SOCK_STREAM` 就是 TCP（UDP 是 `SOCK_DGRAM`，代码里没有）。TCP 之上再套一层最简 HTTP/1.1 POST，元数据放头里。

# 连接粒度：一块一条连接

每块发完就 `close`（`Connection: close`），下一块重新 connect。不是长连接。

代价是每 2 s 一次三次握手 —— 这条链路实测 RTT 10 ms，握手大约 10~20 ms，相对 2 s 的节奏是零点几个百分点，可以忽略。换来的是**隔离**：某条连接卡死或被中间设备掐掉，只影响那一块，不会毒到后面的块。而且这正好是 HTTP POST 的天然形态，将来对接真实云端不用改。

# 为什么不用 UDP

块**内部**必须完整且有序。Opus 包装在 Ogg 分页里，中间丢一个数据报就整块解不开 —— 用 UDP 就得自己实现重传、排序、重组，等于把 TCP 重写一遍。

而**块之间**的容错已经在分块设计里解决了：允许序号不连续，单块最多重试一次。板子上传跟不上时直接丢掉最老的排队块并计数，接收端把缺号报出来。

所以这两层各管一件事：

```
TCP        → 保证一块之内的字节完整、有序
分块协议   → 允许整块缺失，采集永不被网络阻塞
```

拥塞时受损的粒度是「整块 2 s 音频」，而不是「某块中间烂了几个字节」。后者会产生一个无法解码的文件，前者只是时间轴上少一段 —— 对云端 ASR 来说，缺一段远比收到一个坏文件好处理。

# 超时都是有界的

TCP 的默认超时对这个场景太长（connect 能等几十秒），所以三个都显式设了：

```c
STREAM_CONNECT_MS  2000   // 非阻塞 connect + poll，不用系统默认
STREAM_SEND_MS     3000   // SO_SNDTIMEO
STREAM_RECV_MS     1000   // SO_RCVTIMEO
```

`connect` 特意做成非阻塞 + `poll()`：服务器没开的时候，默认行为会让上传线程僵在那里几十秒，期间所有块都被丢弃。2 s 就失败，代价从「几十秒空白」变成「丢一两块 + 一条明确报错」。

（`poll` 返回 `POLLOUT` 还不够 —— 连接被拒绝也会唤醒 poll，所以后面还要用 `getsockopt(SO_ERROR)` 确认，`audio_test_stream.c` 里那段就是干这个的。）

fix(autoflash): report a failed baud restore instead of claiming success
The restore sent stty's stderr to /dev/null and printed the success line
unconditionally, so a restore that did not happen still read as one.
stty needs the port to itself, so a screen session or a stray cat left on
it makes this fail with EBUSY.  The line then stays at the flashing rate
while the script says it is back at the console rate, and whoever attaches
next gets a console that shows garbage and ignores typing, with the one
message that could explain it saying the opposite.
Report the failure, name the likely cause, and print the command to finish

=== 6f63ac94ec3d9a18f5791f0bf254ad0d6fc59548
fix(jpeg_test): decode into the panel buffer instead of the main heap
`show` died at its first allocation on the current baseline: the main heap
is down to 88 KB free in 69 KB of contiguous space, and the command wanted
a 160x160 RGB565 frame plus two reference images of the same size.
Asking in a different order was not enough.  Taking the frame before
jpeg_start_decompress got the frame, then libjpeg failed with
"Insufficient memory (case 4)" against what was left -- the total was
never going to fit, so ordering only decided which half failed.
Two allocations were avoidable rather than merely large:
  - The references were never needed whole.  The pattern is defined per
    pixel, so each row is regenerated on demand and dropped, which is the
    same arithmetic in a different order.  The verdict is unchanged, and it
    stays comparative: error against the reference over error against a
    Cb/Cr-swapped one, 11 against 198 here.
  - The decoded frame belongs in the frame buffer.  It is already RGB565 at
    the panel's size, it lives in PSRAM where 5.7 MB is free, and the frame
    was being copied there anyway.  libjpeg now writes each row straight
    into it, so the main heap is left entirely to libjpeg's pools and one
    full-frame copy disappears.
Rows land at the panel's stride, centred, so the verdict walks the image
with a stride instead of assuming it is packed -- a destination's row
spacing is not something this code gets to assume.
Opening the frame buffer also yields the geometry that jpeg_test_panel_size
used to fetch on its own, and the decode target replaces what
jpeg_test_display copied, so both retire.

fix(autoflash): derive the workspace root instead of hard-coding it

ROOT was the literal string /home/mi/vela_competition.  When this working
copy was renamed, that path did not stop existing -- it is a separate
read-only backup of the same project -- so nothing failed.  The script found
a bk_loader there, found an all-app.bin there, checked its size, printed its
SHA-256, and flashed it.  The build that had just finished sat untouched in
this tree while the board came up running something else.

A wrong image that flashes successfully is the worst failure mode available
here: every marker the script prints says the flash worked, because it did,
and the only way to notice is that the firmware does not have the change in
it.  Twenty minutes were spent on the previous session wondering why a new
command was missing from a board that had just been flashed with it.

Compute ROOT from BASH_SOURCE instead, so the script can only ever act on the
tree it is part of.  The loader has lived at both $ROOT/tools/bk_loader and
$ROOT/bk_loader across copies of this workspace, so take whichever exists
rather than assuming, and derive RUNTIME_DIR from the script's own directory
for the same reason.

Verified: ROOT resolves to /home/mi/vela_competition_continue, and the flash
that followed reported the SHA-256 of the package this tree had just built.

input.text:
fix(bk7258): stop NETINIT_NETLOCAL from compiling out Wi-Fi association

The board associated with nothing and `ifconfig` reported 255.255.255.255.
Everything a working setup needs was already enabled -- CONFIG_BK7258_WIFI,
CONFIG_WIRELESS_WAPI, CONFIG_NETDEVICES -- and the driver brought wlan0 up to
RUNNING, so the failure looked like a driver or a radio problem.

It was neither.  CONFIG_NETINIT_NETLOCAL puts netinit_net_bringup() behind
`#ifndef CONFIG_NETINIT_NETLOCAL`, which means netinit_associate() is not
merely skipped at runtime -- it is not in the firmware at all.  Nothing ever
tried to associate, so there was nothing to diagnose in the parts that were
being looked at.  NETLOCAL exists for a link that carries only local traffic
and needs no address, which is the opposite of what this board does.

Drop it and turn on CONFIG_NETINIT_DHCPC so netinit both associates and asks
for an address.

The SSID and passphrase are deliberately not committed.  This is a public
repository, and CONFIG_NETINIT_WAPI_SSID / CONFIG_NETINIT_WAPI_PASSPHRASE take
plain strings, so anyone building for their own network sets those two locally:

  CONFIG_NETINIT_WAPI_SSID="your-ssid"
  CONFIG_NETINIT_WAPI_PASSPHRASE="your-passphrase"

CONFIG_LIB_OPUS goes in alongside because audio_test now encodes Ogg Opus and
will not link without it.

Verified on the board: association happens during boot, and after one `renew
wlan0` the interface holds 192.168.31.47/24 with the gateway at 192.168.31.1.
Three pings to a host on another subnet: 0% loss, 10 ms average.

The address does not arrive without that manual renew, which is a separate
race between netinit's DHCP attempt and association completing; it is not
addressed here.

input.text:
feat(bk7258): make the capture gain settable at runtime

Choosing the analog microphone gain needs a sweep across the range, and the
gain was only reachable by editing bk7258_audio_dev.c and reflashing.  At four
minutes a flash, sixteen settings is an hour of waiting to answer one
question, and every answer arrives in a different acoustic moment than the
one before it -- which is exactly the variable the sweep is trying to hold
still.

Add BK7258_AUDIOIOC_SET_CAPGAIN, issued before AUDIOIOC_CONFIGURE so the
values are latched by the adc_setup() the driver already runs there, and
expose it as audio_test -m/-d/-p.  A sweep is then one command per setting
inside one session.

What the sweep found, with a fixed source at 16 kHz:

  mic_gain   RMS    peak      noise floor (quiet room)
  0          21.0   179       18.5
  3          77.8   671       34.8
  7          160.9  1399      80.5
  12         466.3  4291      367.2
  15         883.6  5294      896.4

Signal rises 32.5 dB from 0 to 15 and the noise floor rises 33.7 dB with it,
so the analog gain does not improve SNR -- the dominant noise enters ahead of
the gain stage.  It is a level control, not a signal-to-noise control, and it
should be chosen for the level a scene needs: 12 for far-field, 6-7 close up.
Nothing clipped anywhere in the range.

hpf is carried in the same request because the ADC's two high-pass stages are
latched by the same setup path.  They stay bypassed by default: clearing
BK7258_AUD_ADC_HPF1_BYPASS|HPF2_BYPASS makes capture return exact zeroes
(dc=0.0 rms=0.0 peak=0), so the stages are not usable as they are configured
here and the flag exists to keep investigating that without another reflash.

The ioctl number and its argument struct are duplicated in audio_test rather
than shared through a header: applications do not get the board's private src
directory on their include path, and exporting a board header into apps/ to
share one constant would be worse coupling than a documented duplicate.

input.text:
feat(audio_test): encode Ogg Opus, and stream it in chunks while recording

Three things arrive together because each one is what makes the next possible:
an encoder, a way off the board, and a capture that does not have to finish
before either runs.

Ogg Opus, not raw Opus packets.  Opus packets carry no sample rate, channel
count or packet boundaries, so a bare concatenation is not decodable without
side information.  Every recognition service that takes Opus takes it in Ogg
(RFC 7845), which costs 28 bytes of page header plus two small headers.  The
granule positions are in 48 kHz units whatever the input rate, so a 20 ms
frame advances the granule by 960 even though only 320 samples went in at
16 kHz; getting that wrong yields a file that decodes and misreports its own
length.

Getting it off the board, in the order the board could support it:

  - base64 over the console, because there was no network and the AP console
    is a mailbox path rather than a byte stream.  The relay queue, not the
    line rate, is the limit: 16 lines between pauses lost 23 lines out of a
    16 KiB dump, so it pauses every line and a CRC32 is printed with the
    length.  `dump` repeats the last encode so a mangled transfer costs one
    command instead of another recording.
  - `send` over TCP once the network worked, same bytes without base64's
    third of overhead.
  - `pcm` for raw samples, because a 16 kbps encoder is built to discard
    noise-like content, so a noise spectrum measured after it describes the
    encoder as much as the microphone.

Then continuous capture.  `recplay` and `opus` record a whole clip before
anything else happens, which cannot become a live upload: the plan calls for
fixed-length chunks uploaded while the next is still being recorded, and is
explicit that congestion must not block audio, the mailbox heartbeat or the
keys.

`stream` puts a ring of chunk slots between the two halves.  The capture side
does one strided copy into PSRAM per buffer and signals -- no encode, no
socket, nothing that can block -- because a buffer not returned promptly is an
ADC overrun.  The uploader runs on its own thread ten priorities lower, since
NuttX schedules FIFO within a priority and an equal-priority uploader could
hold the CPU across a whole encode.

When the uploader cannot keep up, the oldest queued chunk is dropped and
counted.  Blocking capture would corrupt the recording and growing the ring
without bound would exhaust PSRAM and fail later and less predictably; a gap
in the sequence numbers is something the upload protocol already allows.

Each chunk is a complete Ogg stream with its own headers and its own serial,
not a slice of one long stream.  A slice only decodes after everything before
it has arrived, which contradicts both allowances the plan makes: that a
sequence number may be missing, and that a chunk may be retried alone.  The
encoder is created once and reset per chunk, because without the reset the
first frames of a chunk reference samples that chunk's decoder never saw.

Framed as an HTTP POST per chunk with the metadata in headers (X-Sequence,
X-Start-Ms, X-Duration-Ms, X-Session-Id), so the same bytes work against a
real endpoint and a stand-in receiver stays short.  One connection per chunk:
the handshake is 10-20 ms against a 2 s cadence, and a wedged connection then
costs one chunk instead of the rest of the session.  connect() is
non-blocking with an explicit poll, because the stack's default would sit for
tens of seconds and drop every chunk in the meantime.

The encoder state is forced into PSRAM on this path.  pthread stacks can only
come from the SRAM heap, and letting the 38 KiB encoder state take SRAM first
made pthread_create() fail with ENOMEM.  Leaving that to whichever allocation
ran first would have made it a race, so it is a parameter.

tools/chunk_server.py is the stand-in endpoint: stdlib only, one file per
chunk, and on exit it reports gaps, checks every chunk decodes and matches its
declared duration, then joins them with `-c:a copy` -- moving the packets into
one Ogg stream rather than re-encoding already-lossy audio, which is also 42
times smaller than the decoded WAV it used to write.  The chunks are deleted
only after the joined file has been decoded back, since until then they are
the only copy.

Measured on the board, 15 s at 16 kHz into 2 s chunks:

  chunks captured=8 sent=8 dropped=0 failed=0, worst backlog 2/4
  chunks captured=7 sent=7 dropped=0 failed=0, worst backlog 2/4  (-m 12)

The backlog of 2 is the ring doing its job: the uploader fell a chunk behind
and caught up without dropping anything.  Every chunk decoded standalone at
exactly its declared duration, and the second run measured -26.3 dB mean
against -63.8 dB for the same scene at the default gain.  The 8 full-scale
samples in that run are isolated single samples, which is decoder overshoot on
transients and not ADC clipping -- a clip flattens the waveform for many
samples in a row.

# Derived from this script's own location rather than written down: it lives at
# $ROOT/contest/<team-repo>/.claude/skills/autoflash/, so five levels up is the
# workspace root.  A hard-coded path breaks the moment the workspace is renamed,
# and it fails as "找不到 bk_loader" -- which reads like a missing tool rather
# than a stale path, and costs a build-and-flash cycle to work out.
ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../../../.." && pwd)
input.newStr:
# Found by walking up from this script until a bk_loader turns up, the same way
# the project's own autoflash.sh does it.
#
# It used to be written down as a literal path.  That breaks the moment the
# workspace is renamed, and it breaks in the worst possible way if a directory
# still exists at the old name: the script keeps working and flashes that
# tree's all-app.bin, so every marker says success while the board runs
# something other than what was just built.
#
# Counting "../.." up to the root would fix the rename and still hard-code how
# deep this file sits, which is one more thing to get wrong when a skill moves.
# Searching for the thing that has to be there instead cannot go wrong quietly:
# it either finds a bk_loader or says it found none.
find_root() {
  local dir
  dir=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)

  while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do
    if [ -x "$dir/tools/bk_loader" ] || [ -x "$dir/bk_loader" ]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$dir"
      return 0
    fi

    dir=$(dirname -- "$dir")
  done

  return 1
}

ROOT=$(find_root)

fix(autoflash): find the workspace root in the skill copy too

The project's own autoflash.sh learned to locate the workspace by walking up
until it finds a bk_loader.  The copy under .claude/skills/ did not: it still
carried ROOT=/home/mi/vela_competition_ap_console_dev, a path this machine no
longer has.

A stale literal here fails in two ways and neither is obvious.  If the old
path is gone, the error is "找不到 bk_loader", which reads as a missing tool
rather than a wrong directory.  If something still exists at the old path --
and on this machine a read-only backup of the same project does -- the script
does not fail at all: it flashes that tree's all-app.bin, prints its size and
SHA-256, reports success, and the board comes up running something other than
what was just built.

Use the same find_root walk as the sibling script rather than counting
"../.." up to the root.  Counting would fix the rename and still encode how
deep the file sits, which is one more thing to break when a skill moves;
searching for the thing that must be there cannot go wrong quietly.  Keep the
VELA_WS override, select the loader from either location the way find_root
accepts either, and fail loudly when the walk finds nothing instead of letting
an empty ROOT become a path beginning with a slash.

Verified: ROOT resolves to /home/mi/vela_competition_continue and the loader
and default image both resolve inside it.

The project-level autoflash.sh needs nothing here -- upstream's find_root
already covers this tree, and it is the better implementation of the two, so
this drops the duplicate fix that was written for it.

# WebSocket JSON 协议
服务端地址为 `ws://<电脑局域网IP>:8080/ws`。所有帧均为 UTF-8 文本 JSON，单帧最大 16 KB。连接建立后第一帧必须是 `hello`。服务端会拒绝格式不正确的消息，并以 `error` 回应。
## 1. 板端注册
```json
{"type":"hello","role":"board","deviceId":"bk7258-001","name":"BK7258 演示板","volume":50,"muted":false,"token":"可选密钥"}
```
- `deviceId`：设备稳定唯一标识，长度 1–64，只能使用字母、数字、`.`、`_`、`-`。
- `volume`：0–100 的整数；省略时服务端默认显示 50。
- 若电脑服务配置了 `BOARD_TOKEN`，`token` 必须相同。
- 成功回应：`{"type":"hello_ack","role":"board","deviceId":"bk7258-001",...}`。
## 2. 板端上报语音转写
```json
{"type":"transcript","text":"今天天气怎么样","isFinal":true,"timestamp":"2026-08-16T09:30:00.000Z"}
```

## 3. 板端状态上报
```json
{"type":"device_status","volume":65,"muted":false}
```
在本地音量被按键、命令或其他模块改动后立即上报，让网页读数与实际硬件保持一致。

text:
确认了 —— 你和赵宇涛说的是**两套不同的架构**，他的结论是从他自己那套的前提推出来的。

# 赵宇涛在说什么

他讲的核心是一条硬件事实：

> BK7258 的 WiFi 只能是 **STA 模式**（连别人的路由器上网）**或 AP 模式**（自己当热点），**两者互斥，不能同时开**。

从这条事实，加上他脑子里的一个前提，推出了他的结论：

**他的前提**：网页是**板子自己托管**的 —— 单片机内建一个简易 HTTP 服务，像路由器后台那种。他原话「web是纯本地不联网的单片机自建简易页面」。

**推论链**：
1. 网页在板子上 → 手机/电脑要看网页，就得连板子的热点 → 板子必须开 AP
2. 板子开了 AP → 就不能同时连 WiFi 上网 → 连不到云端
3. 连不到云端 → **就没有"本次会话内容"可显示**
4. 所以你的功能 3（实时显示本次会话）在他那套架构下**物理上不可能**
5. 于是他说「只做前两个就行了」

他还说了网页在他设计里的定位：**主要是配网用的**（板子第一次开机时还没有 WiFi 密码，只能靠热点让你连上去填），顺带加个读文件的能力，「就和路由器一样」。设计哲学是「单片机这个弱交互设备作为 AI 接入点，其他设备不参与除了配网和读取历史记录外的工作」。

他的进度：kvdb 还没打开、热点模式在测、FAT32 128MB NAND 读写已支持、服务器那边不清楚。

# 但你写的不是那套

你的 `openvela-web` 是一个 **跑在电脑上的 Node.js 服务**：

```
package.json   →  "vela-web-console"，依赖 ws，node server.js
.env.example   →  HOST=0.0.0.0  PORT=8080
protocol.md    →  "服务端地址为 ws://<电脑局域网IP>:8080/ws"
server.js:223  →  WebSocketServer({ path: "/ws" })
```

方向是**板子作为客户端主动连到电脑**（发 `hello` + `role:"board"` 注册），浏览器另开一条连接当 `dashboard`：

```
板子 ──WebSocket──> 电脑上的 Node 服务 <──WebSocket── 浏览器
   (STA 模式，和电脑在同一个 WiFi)
```

**这套架构下板子始终是 STA 模式，从来不需要开 AP。** 所以 AP/STA 互斥这条限制**根本不适用**，功能 3 完全可行 —— 你的 `protocol.md` 里 `transcript` 那条消息（带 `isFinal` 流式中间结果）就是干这个的，设计得挺对。

# 姚靖威一直在说的就是这个

他连着提了两次，正是在纠这个前提：

> 「并且都连wifi 的情况下，web 和 设备 也都能在 局域网通信，相互之间走网络也没问题的」

> 「如果要实现更丰富的web 应用功能，局域网是通的，直接做就行，比如 查看会话历史，远程预览摄像头等能力」

他那句「web 的能力太弱了」说的是**赵宇涛那套 AP 网页**弱（只能配网+读文件），不是说你的弱。

他还给了另一条路：「web 上的会话信息是 设备 先发给 服务器，然后再 给 web」—— 让网页从云端服务器取数据，那样连局域网都不需要，板子和网页甚至不用在同一个网络。

# 所以两个东西不冲突，是互补的

| | 赵宇涛的 AP 网页 | 你的局域网 Web 控制台 |
|---|---|---|
| 网页托管在 | 板子里（单片机 HTTP） | 电脑上（Node） |
| 板子 WiFi 模式 | AP | STA |
| 什么时候用 | **第一次配网**，板子还没有 WiFi 密码 | 日常使用，板子已联网 |
| 能做 | 填 WiFi 密码、看文件 | 实时会话、历史、音量、摄像头预览 |
| 能不能上云 | 不能（AP 时没网） | 能 |

配网是**开机第一步**，配完切回 STA，然后你的控制台才能用。时间上先后发生，不是二选一。

赵宇涛最后那段其实已经松口了：「要做局域网访问的话好像和ap web也拉不开差距」—— 他觉得局域网方案相比 AP 网页没多大优势。这一点我认为他判断错了：AP 网页做不了实时会话（没网），局域网能；AP 网页要占掉唯一的 WiFi 模式，局域网不占。差距不是没有，是他把网页的用途预设成「配网+读文件」之后才显得没有。

# 跟你音频那块的一个直接关联

配网这件事正好解掉我之前提醒你的那个问题。

现在 WiFi 的 SSID 和密码是**编译进 defconfig** 的，所以：

- 我不能把那两行提交（public 仓库，密码会永久留在 git 历史里）
- 你每次重新 clone 或 clean 之后要手动加回去才能联网
- 换个网络就得重新编译烧录一次，四分钟

**AP 配网 + kvdb 存储正是这个问题的标准答案**：板子首次开机开热点，你连上去在网页里填 SSID/密码，存进 kvdb，重启切 STA 自动连。以后换网络不用重新编译。

赵宇涛说热点模式正在测、kvdb 还没打开，刘澄说 kvdb 他做了一部分在验证 —— 这两块一落地，defconfig 里那两行就可以彻底删掉。**这件事值得你在群里主动跟他们对一下**，因为它同时解决他们的配网需求和我们的凭据问题。

# 建议你怎么回

大意可以是：

> 我的 web 是跑在电脑上的 Node 服务，板子作为 WebSocket 客户端连上来（STA 模式），不需要板子开热点，所以功能 3 实时会话是可行的，AP/STA 互斥不影响这套。你说的 AP 网页我理解是配网用的，那个我们需要 —— 现在 WiFi 密码是编译进 defconfig 的，换网络得重烧固件，配网页面 + kvdb 落地之后就能去掉。两个是先后关系不是二选一：配网用你的 AP 页面，配完切 STA 用我的控制台。

要不要我帮你把这段整理成更适合直接发群里的措辞？另外你的 `openvela-web` 我可以顺手过一遍代码，看看板子侧要对接 WebSocket 需要补什么（现在板子上只有我写的那个 HTTP POST 分块上传，没有 WebSocket 客户端）。

查完了 —— 先说一个可能出乎你意料的结论。

# 这个配网 web **还不存在**

我在整个仓库里搜了 `softap` / `httpd` / `http_server` / `webserver` / `配网` / `kvdb`：

- **板子侧没有任何 HTTP 服务代码**，没有 AP 模式配网代码
- **kvdb 在 `.c`/`.h` 里零命中**，这个仓库里还没开始
- SoftAP 只在厂商 BK SDK（CP 侧 lwip / wpa_supplicant）里有 —— 能力在 SDK 里，但本项目没有任何代码用它

对应赵宇涛自己说的进度：「现在还没打开kvdb数据库支持，热点模式正在测试中」。所以现在能讲的只是**他的意图**，不是已有功能。

# 他说的功能，就三件

从他原话拆出来：

# 目前配网实际是怎么做的（手敲命令）

仓库里 `使用说明-camera-display-ai_agent.md:192` 有现成的流程 —— 这就是那个 web 页面将来要替代的东西：

```sh
ifup wlan0
wapi scan wlan0                 # encode=8000 是开放网络
wapi psk wlan0 <密码> 3         # 开放热点跳过
wapi essid wlan0 <SSID> 1
renew wlan0                     # 首次可能失败，重试一次
ifconfig wlan0                  # RUNNING 且地址不是 10.0.0.2 才算成
```

所以那个 web 页面的本质就是：**把这五条命令做成一个表单**。扫描结果列成列表让你选 SSID、输入框填密码、点提交 → 板子在后台执行等价的 wapi 调用 → 存进 kvdb → 重启切 STA。

`ai_agent` 那边还规划了 `set_wifi` / `wifi_reconnect` 两个命令做同一件事，状态是 ⬜（未实现）。也就是说**配网这件事现在有两条并行的规划**（agent 命令 / AP 网页），都没落地。

# 一个你需要知道的冲突

那份文档的前提是「**开机不自动联网，`CONFIG_NETINIT_NETLOCAL`**」。

而我这次提交**恰恰删掉了 `CONFIG_NETINIT_NETLOCAL`** —— 因为它把 `netinit_net_bringup()` 整个编译掉了，导致板子永远不会自动关联，这是之前 WiFi 连不上的根因。

两者的取向是相反的：

| | NETLOCAL=y（文档/配网流程的前提） | 我改成 DHCPC（当前代码） |
|---|---|---|
| 开机行为 | 不自动联网，等你手敲 wapi 配网 | 自动用编译进去的 SSID/密码关联 |
| 适合 | 配网流程、AP 模式 | 固定网络环境下开箱即用 |

短期不冲突（我的改动让开发时不用每次手敲），但**配网功能一落地，NETLOCAL 或类似的"开机先不连、等配置"逻辑就得回来** —— 否则板子开机就用编译进去的旧密码去连，配网页面没有介入的时机。

正确的终态应该是：**凭据从 kvdb 读**，读到就自动连（相当于现在的 DHCPC 行为），读不到就开热点等配网。这样两边都成立，defconfig 里那两行明文密码也能彻底删掉 —— 就是我上一条提醒你的那个问题。

两个是不同层面的东西，你把它们归到一起了 —— 只有 TLS 和传输有关。

# KVDB = 存储，不是传输

**Key-Value Database**，键值数据库。就是在 Flash 上存 `键 = 值` 的一张表：

```
wifi.ssid      = "AIPC"
wifi.password=***REDACTED***
audio.volume   = 65
audio.mic_gain = 12
```

它解决的是「**掉电之后还记得**」这一件事，和网络毫无关系。板子重启、断电、重烧固件（如果分区没擦），这些值还在。

对比一下现在的做法：

| | 现在（编译进 defconfig） | 用 KVDB |
|---|---|---|
| 值存在哪 | 固件二进制里 | Flash 上的独立分区 |
| 改一个值 | **重新编译 + 烧录，4 分钟** | 一条命令，立即生效 |
| 换 WiFi 网络 | 重烧固件 | 填个表单 |
| 能不能进 git | 不能（密码会永久留在历史里） | 不进 git，本来就在设备上 |

这正是我前面反复提醒你的那个问题的解法。Vela 里那些 `persist.xxx` 属性（比如 `persist.miwear_mode`、`persist.ota.*`）背后就是 KVDB。

**当前状态**：`# CONFIG_KVDB is not set` —— 框架里有，但这个固件没开。对应赵宇涛说的「还没打开kvdb数据库支持」，刘澄说「我做了一部分，还在测试验证」。

# TLS = 传输加密

**Transport Layer Security**，就是 HTTPS 里那个 S。它在 TCP 之上加一层，干三件事：

| | 作用 | 没有它会怎样 |
|---|---|---|
| **加密** | 内容变成密文 | 同一 WiFi 下任何人抓包就能听到你的录音 |
| **完整性** | 内容被改会被发现 | 中间人可以篡改音频或识别结果 |
| **身份认证** | 用证书确认服务器是它自称的那个 | 可能把录音发给假冒的服务器 |

你在文档里看到的这行就是它：

```
Handshake OK: TLSv1.2 / TLS-DHE-RSA-WITH-AES-256-CBC-SHA
SUCCESS! HTTP Status: 200
```

板子和云端（`api.xiaomimimo.com`）握手成功。`net_test` 这个命令测的就是这条链路。

# 顺便说一个我自己代码的缺口

既然聊到这，我得指出**我写的音频上传没有 TLS**：

```
audio_test_stream.c:309   socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0)      ← 裸 TCP
audio_test_stream.c:441   "POST /v1/audio/chunk HTTP/1.1"      ← 明文 HTTP
```

当前固件里 `# CONFIG_CRYPTO_MBEDTLS is not set`，连 TLS 库都没编进去。

对现在的用途没问题 —— 接收端是你自己电脑上的假服务器，走局域网。但**真接到云端就是问题**：传的是会话录音，明文过网络意味着同网段任何人抓包都能听。而 `ai_agent` 那条路径已经在用 TLS 了，所以标准是明确的。

这里有个具体的技术权衡值得先想清楚：**我现在是每块一条新连接**（2 秒一次）。加上 TLS 之后，每条新连接都要做一次完整握手 —— RSA/DHE 的数学运算在这颗 MCU 上不便宜，实测那条日志里的 `TLS-DHE-RSA-WITH-AES-256-CBC-SHA` 握手对 480 MHz 的 Cortex-M33 来说是几百毫秒量级的活。2 秒一块、每块握手一次，开销就不能忽略了，还会挤占 CPU 影响采集。

所以接 TLS 的时候大概要改成：**长连接 + session 复用**，而不是保持现在这种一块一连。这会牵动我现在那个「一块一连保证隔离」的设计 —— 隔离性和握手成本得重新平衡一次。

现在不用改。等云端接口确定了（真实 endpoint、要不要 HTTPS、认证方式）再动，否则是在猜需求。但你心里要有这个数：**上云之前这条路径必须加 TLS，而且顺带要重新考虑连接粒度。**

# 一句话区分

```
KVDB  →  存在板子上，掉电不丢     →  解决「配置写死在固件里」
TLS   →  在网络上传输时加密       →  解决「录音明文过网络」
```

一个管落盘，一个管上路，唯一的交集是**配网**：KVDB 存 WiFi 凭据，连上网之后才有机会用 TLS 上云。

HTTPS 就是 **HTTP + TLS**。协议语法完全一样 —— 同样的 `POST`、同样的头、同样的 body，区别只在于这些字节在网上是不是明文。

# 线上传的是什么

```
HTTP:                              HTTPS:
  ┌─────────────────┐                ┌─────────────────┐
  │ POST /upload    │                │ POST /upload    │   ← 应用层完全相同
  │ Content-Length  │                │ Content-Length  │
  │ <音频数据>       │                │ <音频数据>       │
  └────────┬────────┘                └────────┬────────┘
           │                                  │
           │                         ┌────────▼────────┐
           │                         │   TLS 加密层     │  ← 多这一层
           │                         └────────┬────────┘
  ┌────────▼────────┐                ┌────────▼────────┐
  │      TCP        │                │      TCP        │
  └─────────────────┘                └─────────────────┘
   默认端口 80                        默认端口 443
   抓包直接看到内容                    抓包只看到密文
```

端口号只是惯例，不决定加不加密。我给你的上传用的是 9001，那是自定义端口，仍然是明文。

# TLS 加的是三件事，不只是「加密」

| | 没有 TLS | 有 TLS |
|---|---|---|
| **保密性** | 同网段任何人抓包，直接读到录音 | 只看到密文 |
| **完整性** | 中间人可以改字节，你察觉不到 | 改一个 bit 就会握手/解密失败 |
| **身份认证** | 你不知道对面是不是真的服务器 | 用证书验证域名，假冒服务器过不了 |

第三条最容易被忽略但很关键：只加密不认证的话，中间人可以冒充服务器和你建立一条加密连接 —— 加密得很好，只是加密给了错误的人。

# 你们项目现在的实际情况

我写的分块上传是**明文 HTTP**：

```c
audio_test_stream.c:309   socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0)      // 裸 TCP
audio_test_stream.c:441   "POST /v1/audio/chunk HTTP/1.1\r\n"
                          "X-Session-Id: %08lx\r\n"
                          "X-Sequence: %lu\r\n"
                          ...
                          <Ogg Opus 字节原样>
```

body 就是 Ogg 文件本身，一个字节没变 —— 这点我实测过：板子端 crc32 `0xc7176403`，电脑端收到的文件 crc32 完全一致。也就是说**抓包的人拿到的就是一个能直接播放的 ogg 文件**。

而 `ai_agent` 那条路已经在用 TLS 了：

```
Handshake OK: TLSv1.2 / TLS-DHE-RSA-WITH-AES-256-CBC-SHA
SUCCESS! HTTP Status: 200
```

所以项目里标准是明确的，是我这条音频路径还没跟上。当前固件连库都没编进去（`# CONFIG_CRYPTO_MBEDTLS is not set`）。

# HTTPS 也藏不住的东西

这点值得知道，别对它期望过高：

- **IP 地址**：谁在和谁通信是公开的
- **DNS 查询**：访问哪个域名通常还是明文（除非用 DoH/DoT）
- **数据量和时序**：每 2 秒发 4KB 这个模式一看就知道是在传音频流

TLS 保护的是**内容**，不是**通信这件事本身**。

# 这颗芯片上加 TLS 的两个实际障碍

**1. 握手成本**

芯片有硬件 TRNG（`bk7258_trng.h`，给熵池用），但**我没有找到 AES/SHA 硬件加速的驱动** —— 板级头文件和 SDK components 里都没搜到。如果确实没有加速，`DHE-RSA` 那套公钥运算就得纯软件跑在 480 MHz 的 M33 上。

具体多慢**我没实测**，不编数字给你。但结构上的问题是确定的：**我现在是每块一条新连接**（2 秒一次），每条新连接都要完整握手一次。这个设计在明文下很划算（握手 10~20 ms，换来连接隔离），加上 TLS 之后就要重新算账 —— 大概得改成长连接 + session 复用，牺牲一点隔离性。

**2. 板子没有实时时钟 —— 这个更麻烦**

证书验证要检查有效期，而有效期需要知道**当前真实时间**。我有直接证据表明板子不知道：

我的代码里 `ctx->session = (uint32_t)time(NULL)`，第一次跑出来的会话 id 是 `000000f9` = **249**。也就是说 `time(NULL)` 返回的是**开机秒数，不是 Unix 时间戳**。`date` 命令也没编进去。

后果：证书的 `notBefore`/`notAfter` 没法正确校验。要么先用 SNTP 对时（多一个依赖，而且对时本身在没网时做不了 —— 鸡生蛋），要么关掉时间校验（那就丢掉了「证书没过期」这一层保障，被吊销/过期的证书也能通过）。

# 结论

现在不用改。接收端是你自己电脑上的假服务器、走局域网，明文没有实际风险。
